articles.title: In 2001, Paul McCartney started Adopt-A-Minefield campaign to promote complete eradication of landmines
articles.description: Paul McCartney spearheaded the Adopt-A-Minefield initiative in 2001, aiming to combat the devastating impact of landmines worldwide. High-profile benefit events helped secure the necessary resources to assist both land clearance and minefield survivors, resulting in significant achievements. The campaign ended in January 2015 due to financial challenges.
